description_en: Updates a class by calling UpdateClass
name: UpdateClass

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the class
parameters.name: class_id

parameters.help_en: The class title. The value can contain letters and Chinese characters and is up to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 课程标题，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the creator. The value can contain letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 创建人用户ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符
parameters.name: create_user_id

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the creator. The value can contain letters and Chinese characters and is up to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 创建人用户昵称，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: create_nickname
